h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolhapur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kolhapur

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to municipal gardens, housing societies, schools and walking tracks in Kolhapur. Our Fun Fitness range is made at our factory in Vasai, about 330 km away. We deliver it to Kolhapur by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

An open-air gym works well in Kolhapur's gardens and lake-side walking areas, where people already come out early in the morning. Our machines use the person's own body weight, so they suit beginners and senior citizens as much as regular walkers, and they need no electricity or adjustment. A society can start with three or four machines along its walking path and add more later, since each station stands on its own base.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit senior citizens?
items.a: Low-impact machines such as the Fun Walker, Tai Chi and seated twisters. They use the person's own body weight and need no adjustment.

items.q: Do you install open gym equipment in Kolhapur?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road and install the machines with our own team or a local dealer, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.

items.q: How much space does an outdoor gym need?
items.a: It depends on the number of machines. Send us the size of the area and we will suggest a layout with enough clear space around each station.
